AbilityDef.label: assimilate
AbilityDef.description:
Inject a downed person or a prisoner with nanoprobes. Over about three days the nanoprobes rebuild them into a Slorg drone who joins this drone's faction. Any skill they know better than the collective becomes the collective's, for as long as they live.

Ordinary tending only slows the infection. Exceptional tends, which need glitterworld medicine, purge it.

Resistance is futile.
